systems.tiers: project under way in May 2020 for electronic payment of taxes and other revenue of accounting posts, collectivités and national public establishments

note: A central bank's regional guide to digitalising State payments: for Côte d'Ivoire it lists payment initiatives, among them a Treasury payment platform covering local authorities' revenue, then in project (BCEAO, May 2020). It states nothing about a local government office's connection.
